raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / ATTICO CON SOLARIUM A JESOLO LIDO FOR SALE · PENTHOUSE Attico con Solarium a Jesolo Lido PIAZZA AURORA · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €1,300,000 Photos (32) Floor plans (2) 1 / 32 FLOOR AREA 200 m² BEDROOMS 3 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT Yes ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo Lido! An elegant penthouse located just 50 meters from the beach, in the heart of the renowned Piazza Aurora area. An exclusive solution that combines spacious areas, modern comforts, and a location among the most sought-after on the coast. The residence is spread over two levels: on the first level there is a bright living area with a living room and kitchenette, overlooking terraces that enhance continuity between indoors and outdoors, creating an airy atmosphere filled with natural light. The sleeping area features three spacious bedrooms and two windowed bathrooms, designed to ensure comfort, privacy, and quality living. All complemented by underfloor heating and energy class A4, ensuring efficiency and well-being in every season. The true highlight of this property is the second level: an extraordinary solarium terrace of about 150 sqm, a private rooftop with panoramic views over the sea and all of Jesolo. A unique space for enjoying moments of relaxation, outdoor dining, summer evenings, and breathtaking sunsets. As it is newly constructed, flooring materials and finishes can be customized according to client preferences offering the opportunity to create a tailor-made home. Completing this property are two covered parking spaces on the ground floor—an additional value added in one of the city's most desirable areas. A high-level solution where space, view, and location combine to offer an exclusive living experience in Jesolo.
